packageRules.description: Ported from dependabot.yml's `astro` group: astro and @astrojs/* majors move together, because the @astrojs packages track astro's major. Non-major updates are already in the preset's single group.

site/package.json `overrides` are hand-maintained advisory fixes for transitive packages, kept inside the range their parents ask for (katex is the documented exception) and dropped once the parents move past them; see AGENTS.md. Renovate would bump them past that range (for example js-yaml 4 -> 5), so leave them alone.
